title: LivaChat Common Definitions
description: Shared schema definitions reused across all message types. Synchronized with ws-protocol-design.md v1.3.

SessionId.description: Session identifier: 'sess_' prefix + 18 random lowercase alphanumeric characters.

MessageId.description: AI reply message identifier: 'msg_' prefix + 12 random lowercase alphanumeric characters.

TranscriptionId.description: Transcription batch identifier: 'trans_' prefix + 12 random lowercase alphanumeric characters.

DeviceId.description: Client device UUID v4, generated on first launch and persisted in secure storage.

JwtToken.description: JWT Bearer token in standard three-segment base64url encoding.

SeqNumber.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number per direction. Starts at 1 on connection, resets on disconnect. Client and server maintain independent sequences.

Timestamp.description: Sender-local UTC wall-clock time in milliseconds since Unix epoch. Used for one-way delay calculation and audio/video frame synchronization.

ClientVersion.description: Client version with platform prefix. Android: 'android-<versionName>.<versionCode>' (e.g. 'android-1.0.0.130'); the 4th segment is optional for backward compatibility with old clients. iOS may append its build number.

AudioSampleRate.description: Audio sample rate in Hz. Supported values: 16000 or 24000.

AvDetectorSwitch.description: Per-session AVDetector switch. 'enable' = allow proactive audio/video detection; 'disable' = do not attach the detector for this session.

VadState.description: Per-frame VAD state. Server uses consecutive silence frames (≥600ms) to detect end of user turn. 'muted' marks client mic-mute flush frames (docs/android_audio_capture.md §5.2): server substitutes each of them with a 20ms zero PCM frame downstream instead of decoding.

AudioCodec.description: Audio codec identifier. Always 'opus' in MVP.

AudioDurationMs.description: Audio frame duration in milliseconds. Opus frame length.

JpegQuality.description: JPEG compression quality (1-100). Client adapts dynamically based on estimated upstream bandwidth. Recommended range: 60-80.

Orientation.description: Camera frame rotation in degrees (the rotation needed to display the image upright).

CameraFacing.description: Which source produced the frame. 'screen' = screen capture, 'gallery' = user-selected gallery photo (neither is a live camera).

StatusReasonCode.description: Reason code for session status transitions.

InterruptReason.description: Reason for user interrupt. 'user_voice': VAD detected user speech. 'manual': user tapped interrupt button.

type.description: Message type discriminator. Determines payload schema.
